text: LG Electronics Canada, Inc. (LGECI) is the Canadian subsidiary of LG Electronics, Inc., a consumer-electronics group headquartered in Seoul, South Korea; LG Electronics' consolidated financial statements list LGECI with a 100% controlling interest.
short: LG Electronics Canada is wholly owned by LG Electronics, Inc.
